profile.headline: Software Engineer at Calix
profile.summary:
•	Skilled embedded software engineer with 13 years of experience in embedded software development for networking products such as Wi-Fi Router, 10G DPoE EPON ONU and xDSL modem.
•	Proficient in C; Familiar with shell script, XML, HTML; Understanding of Pearl and Python.
•	Experience in Linux driver, CFE, kernel, shared and user space.
•	Knowledge of networking protocols and applications along with diverse telecom configurations.
•	Strong analytical and debugging skills combined with experience in QA.
•	Competent team player through complete project cycles, testing and customer services. 
•	Self-driven and self-motivated.
•	Legally authorized to work in the U.S. (U.S. Citizen)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Integrate EasyMesh opensource PrplMesh
- Develop advanced authorization process for Hotspot.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Act as a software lead and develop software on Linux embedded system using c for 10G DPoE EPON ONU.

-	Have in-depth knowledge of DPoE OAM specification as well as TCP/IP Protocol.
-	Troubleshoot and resolve customer issues in lab, via remote access and on-site.
-	Set up testing environment for OLT(Optical Line Termination) provisioning.
-	Document release notes, instructions and SOPs using Windows Office and Linux LibreOffice.
-	Currently participating RFP process for a Femtocell project based on CBRS.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and manage DSL products mainly based on BRCM solutions and LTE/M2M devices based on MTK platforms.

- System-wise integration and porting with Broadcom platforms. (From driver to userspace)
- Excellent Linux programming skill using C, HTML, JavaScript and Pearl.
- In-depth knowledge of TCP/IP, understand diverse telecommunication configurations well.
- Capability to setup various testing environment such as IPTV, PPPoE Server, snmpwalk, PRTG....etc.
- Familiar with various tools such as Wireshark, Chariot, Iperf, Calix TR069, TFTP32, Packet Builder, iwconfig, wpa_supplicant, inSSIDER...etc.
- Work closely with customers, venders, manufacturers, QA and FAE.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Manage networking related assignments including Wireless, Ethernet, DLNA, UPnP and Live streaming for IPTV. Travel to Japan, United States and Mexico for on-site support.

- Build a SOP for networking related certifications such as Wi-Fi, DLNA and UPnP.
- Debug software related issues for third parties such as Netflix and SEN.
- Arrange a training course for production engineers in Mexico.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for software developing based on embedded system for Integrated Access Device (IAD), Wireless Access Point (AP) and Set-Top Box (STB). 

- Act as a software contact window and develop embedded software for 5-GHz band AP.
- Develop 3D GUI for STB. (OpenGL ES1.1)
- Use Python and OOA/OOD methodologies to develop an ATS that runs most of the functionality tests for IAD project.
- Write test plans and document testing environment configurations.
- Verify software functions including VoIP, IEEE802.11 b/g/n, DMZ, Port trigger/forward, IP/MAC/URL filter, IPSec, Firware(SPI), IGMP, Interface Group, Printer Server and Storage Service.

positions.title: DQA Engineer
positions.description: Design quality assurance for Multiple Inkjet printer
